name: roseline-mcp
description: Roslyn code intelligence for C# — symbols, references, call graphs, and surgical edits over MCP.
long_description:
RoselineMCP gives AI coding agents a semantic view of your C# solution via Roslyn: search symbols, inspect definitions, find references and implementations, walk call graphs and type hierarchies, and apply surgical, member-level edits — so the agent navigates by *structure* instead of re-reading source (measured ~89% fewer tokens, median, on navigation tasks).

Requires the **.NET 10 SDK** on your machine: this bundle launches the server on demand with `dnx` (the SDK's NuGet tool runner), and the analysis tools load your real `.sln`/`.csproj` through MSBuild, which needs the SDK present. Nothing is pre-installed — `dnx` fetches and caches the `RoselineMCP` NuGet package on first use.

tools.name: analyze_solution
tools.description: Analyze a C# solution for diagnostics with include/exclude/severity filtering.

tools.name: list_diagnostics
tools.description: Detailed diagnostics for a project with statistics and suggested fixable IDs.

tools.name: apply_fixes
tools.description: Apply automated Roslyn/Roslynator code fixes; preview-only by default.

tools.name: check_compilation
tools.description: Does this code compile right now, and what broke? Compiler errors only, in under a second on a warm workspace — use instead of running `dotnet build` after an edit. Read-only.

tools.name: create_patch
tools.description: Generate a unified diff between two text versions.

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Find symbols by wildcard/substring, or outline a single file.

tools.name: get_symbol_info
tools.description: A symbol's kind, signature, base types, interfaces, docs, and definition (optionally source).

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Every use site of a symbol across the solution.

tools.name: find_implementations
tools.description: Implementations, overrides, and derived types of a symbol.

tools.name: get_call_graph
tools.description: A cycle-safe caller/callee graph for a method, depth-bounded.

tools.name: get_type_hierarchy
tools.description: A type's base-class chain, interfaces, and derived types.

tools.name: get_symbol_at_position
tools.description: The symbol at a file:line(:column) — turn a diagnostic, stack trace, or grep hit into a symbol name.

tools.name: edit_member
tools.description: Replace, add, or delete a single type member; preview-only by default.

tools.name: rename_symbol
tools.description: Roslyn solution-wide rename of a symbol and all its references; preview-only by default.
